description: This file contains unit tests for the EagerOperation class in the TensorFlow Java API, verifying functionality such as creation, data types, shapes, inputs, outputs, and session management.

classes.name: EagerOperationTest
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for testing EagerOperation functionalities.

methods.name: failToCreateIfSessionIsClosed
methods.description: Tests that creating an operation with a closed session throws an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: outputDataTypeAndShape
methods.description: Verifies setting attribute data types and shapes on operations.

methods.name: outputTensor
methods.description: Tests retrieval of output tensor values, shapes, and data types from operations.

methods.name: inputAndOutputListLengths
methods.description: Checks lengths of input/output lists for operations with multiple inputs and outputs.

methods.name: numOutputs
methods.description: Verifies the number of outputs an operation produces.

methods.name: opNotAccessibleIfSessionIsClosed
methods.description: Ensures operations are not accessible if the session they belong to is closed.

methods.name: outputIndexOutOfBounds
methods.description: Validates that accessing out-of-bounds output indices throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.
